text: Overfitting occurs when a machine learning model learns the training data too closely and performs poorly on unseen data.
Regularization reduces overfitting by penalizing overly complex models during training.
Cross-validation estimates how well a machine learning model generalizes to unseen data.
Underfitting occurs when a model is too simple to capture important patterns in the training data.
Decision trees make predictions by recursively splitting data according to feature values.
Neural networks consist of interconnected artificial neurons organized into layers.
Gradient descent updates model parameters to reduce a loss function during training.
Convolutional neural networks are widely used for image recognition and computer vision.
Python supports object-oriented programming through classes, objects, inheritance, and polymorphism.
A stack follows the last-in, first-out principle and supports push and pop operations.
The gravitational force between two masses depends on their masses and the distance between them.
The Fourier transform represents a signal in terms of its frequency components.
